profile.name: YDLIDAR 二维激光雷达
profile.description: 一种通过串口连接的二维激光测距传感器，用于持续采集周围环境的距离与角度扫描数据，常用于机器人避障、环境感知与建图。
profile.description_en: A serially connected 2D laser rangefinding sensor that continuously acquires distance-and-angle scan data of the surrounding environment, commonly used for robot obstacle avoidance, perception, and mapping.

registry.name: YDLIDAR Adapted from https://github.com/Ezward/rplidar
registry.description: YD Lidar是由YDLIDAR生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括初始化、扫描、绘图、读取数据、运行。支持Signal, Slot, angle in bounds等操作。
